2. **Migration 1:** Moved to `.claude/skills/` (Claude-specific location)
3. **Migration 2:** Moved to `.agent/skills/` (universal Agent Skills standard)

All AI agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, etc.) should use the skills in `.agent/skills/`.
